6. Whilst Muslims are not a distinct ethnic group, unlawful discrimination against a person
because they are Muslim would be captured under the EqA 2010 as religious discrimination.

7. Common practices and terms are explained in appendix D (Glossary of religions).
The diversity of religious practice

8. For the first time, in 2021, fewer than half of the population of England and Wales described
themselves as Christian, while increasing numbers (over a third) described themselves as of
“no religion”.

438 The importance of understanding different religious practice is tied to access
to justice, as people’s practices may impact on every aspect of their lives, from work to
interaction with the justice system.
